changeSet.author: grushton
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ontology_index ( id varchar(255) primary key, obo_id varchar(56), version varchar(255) not null, ontology varchar(255) not null, label text not null, definition text, synonyms text, json_document jsonb, usable boolean not null, create_user_id integer not null, create_date timestamp without time zone default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null, update_user_id integer, update_date timestamp without time zone, search_vector tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( to_tsvector( 'english', coalesce(id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(obo_id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(label, '') || ' ' || coalesce(definition, '') || ' ' || coalesce(synonyms, '') ) ) STORED );
CREATE INDEX idx_ontology_index_search_vector ON ontology_index USING GIN (search_vector);
